questions.q: Does Quick Find only exist on Setup's main sidebar, according to this lesson?
options: No — Object Manager has its own Quick Find box, scoped to the list on its current page
Quick Find was removed from Salesforce entirely
Yes, Quick Find exists in exactly one place in all of Salesforce
No, Quick Find only exists in the App Launcher, never in Setup
questions.explain: Quick Find also appears inside Object Manager, filtering whatever list (like Fields & Relationships) is currently in view.

questions.q: What does this lesson say about the App Launcher's search box?
options: It works on the same live-filter pattern as Quick Find, narrowing results as you type with matches highlighted
It only searches installed apps, never other items
It is unrelated to Quick Find's filtering behavior
It requires pressing Enter before any results appear
questions.explain: The App Launcher's search box uses the same live-filter pattern as Quick Find, narrowing results instantly with highlighted matches.

questions.q: Per this lesson's rule, which search box should you use if you already know the exact name of the Setup page you need?
options: Search Setup, because it searches every Setup page in the org by name from anywhere
The sidebar's Quick Find, because it always searches the whole org
None — you must scroll the sidebar manually
Object Manager's Quick Find, regardless of what you're looking for
questions.explain: Search Setup searches every Setup page in the org by name, which is the right tool when you already know the page's name.

questions.q: Per this lesson's rule, when should you use the sidebar's Quick Find instead of Search Setup?
options: Quick Find and Search Setup are described as functionally identical with no difference
Only on mobile devices
When you're already browsing a category and just want to narrow what's currently in view
Only when you don't know how to spell the page name
questions.explain: The sidebar's Quick Find filters whatever category list is currently in view, which is the right tool when you're already browsing that list.

questions.q: What does Object Manager's own Quick Find box filter, per this lesson?
options: Only installed AppExchange packages
The list on that specific object's page, such as its Fields & Relationships
Every Setup page in the entire org
Nothing — Object Manager has no search functionality
questions.explain: Object Manager's Quick Find is scoped to the list on that specific object's page, such as its fields or page layouts.
